weather_line: Northeast breeze · cartographic conditions ideal · ducks oriented

stories.headline: Map Rotated Seventeen Degrees; Lines Converge; the Convergence Point Is, Improbably, Here
body: A breakthrough in the Duck Bandit investigation occurred Sunday morning when Junior Cartographer Hestia Monks of the Wizarding Jeep Enthusiasts' Society (WJES) rotated the existing incident map by seventeen degrees counterclockwise — 'on instinct,' she told this reporter, 'and because it looked like it wanted to be tilted' — and discovered that all seven lines of duck orientation converge on a single point with a precision that the un-rotated map entirely lacked.

The convergence point is, according to the corrected map, the precise location of Christine and Steve's Jeep. Not the general vicinity. Not the road. The Jeep. 'We have checked this four times,' said Monks, who appeared simultaneously delighted and unsettled. 'The ducks have been pointing here the entire time. Every single one of them.'

A new duck was discovered on the Jeep Sunday morning: a small figure wearing a hand-stitched waistcoat in a warm burgundy wool, seated facing northeast — which is to say, facing directly back along the line toward the farthest-flung incident site. The WJES has noted, with some gravity, that the dressed ducks now form a closed circuit. The Duck Bandit, whoever they are, appears to have been building something. Investigators are not yet certain what.

stories.headline: Sunday Proposes a Quiet Morning; the Household Accepts; Terms Negotiated Individually by Each Animal
body: Sunday arrived at the household with the measured confidence of a day that knows it has nowhere to be. Christine accepted its terms warmly and relocated to the porch, which — following the events of Saturday — has been noted to carry a particular settled quality, as though it too has resolved something.

Steve, for his part, spent the early portion of the morning in the garage conducting what he described as 'a routine conversation' with the Jeep. Sources close to the garage report that the Jeep's response, while largely nonverbal, was considered positive. The enchanted vehicle is said to have accepted the news about the convergence map with characteristic composure.

stories.section: Ministry Watch · Department of Geographical Anomalies
stories.headline: Ministry Issues Advisory: 'If Your Rubber Ducks Have Been Pointing at Something, It May Be Intentional; Please Await Further Guidance'
body: The Department of Geographical Anomalies issued a formal advisory Sunday afternoon following the WJES's corrected map findings, confirming that the convergence pattern constitutes what they are calling a 'Grade Two Purposeful Array' — a classification that had not been used since 1987, when a series of garden gnomes in Shropshire were found to be oriented toward a very good pie shop.

The advisory recommends that the owner of the convergence-point vehicle 'remain observant, do not move the ducks, and consider that someone may be trying to tell you something.' The Department declined to speculate on what that something might be, citing 'active cartographic proceedings.' Insiders noted the advisory was issued on a Sunday, which is either very serious or somebody wanted an excuse to send an owl.

stories.headline: Lucy Observed Near Jeep at Precisely 4:47 a.m.; Witness Is Only the Moon; Moon Declines to File Statement
body: In a development investigators have carefully noted and equally carefully declined to draw conclusions from, Lucy was observed in proximity to the Jeep at 4:47 a.m. Sunday — approximately four hours before the waistcoated duck was discovered. She was found at breakfast in her usual location, wearing her usual expression of complete and well-rested innocence.

When asked directly whether she had any knowledge of the duck, the waistcoat, or the seventeen-degree map correction that would be required to make all lines converge on this exact property, Lucy declined to comment. The WJES has added her to the witness log under 'Persons of Interest — Cannot Be Formally Charged With Anything' — a category they have had to expand twice this week.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Spent Sunday morning in the garden, in the sun, thinking about nothing in particular — or so she appeared to be doing, which, her household colleagues have noted, is when she is thinking hardest.
Ellie: Discovered the porch had a second railing this morning and greeted it as a new friend. It did not creak. She considered this very good manners.

Jersey: Identified Sunday as an occasion warranting a full reconfiguration of lap-occupancy strategy; relocated twice before settling into a position widely regarded as the optimal arrangement available on Earth.
founding_editor_note: That seventeen-degree correction is exactly how I used to find true level on a hillside lot — sometimes the ground is fine, you've just been reading it wrong. — D.

in_brief.sport: Sunday Quidditch fixtures postponed; stadium ducks reported facing northeast; officials reviewing implications.
in_brief.forecast: Clear skies through morning, with a deepening sense that all of this has been leading somewhere specific — mild through evening, convergence expected.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
storyline_updates.summary: Day 4: The WJES map, rotated seventeen degrees, reveals all seven duck-orientation lines converging precisely on Christine and Steve's Jeep. A new duck appeared Sunday morning wearing a burgundy waistcoat, facing northeast — completing a closed circuit. The Ministry has issued a Grade Two Purposeful Array advisory. Lucy was observed near the Jeep at 4:47 a.m. and declines to comment. The Duck Bandit appears to have been constructing a deliberate pattern pointing to this household. Day 5 (resolution) should reveal the Bandit's identity or purpose — a warm, funny payoff. Lucy's possible involvement may be confirmed or left gloriously ambiguous. The revelation should feel earned and affectionate.
